hyperedges.label: AB Capital CRM System (Landing + CRM Frontend + Evolution API)

nodes.label: Evolution API v2 (WhatsApp Integration)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as WhatsApp gateway because it provides a REST API with webhook support, QR code pairing, and instance management. Enables the CRM to send/receive messages without needing official WhatsApp Business API access.

nodes.label: SQLite (better-sqlite3) Database
nodes.rationale: SQLite chosen because it requires no external setup, simplifying deployment. Database stored at ./db/crm.sqlite.

nodes.label: Mass Broadcast Feature (Disparos em Massa)
nodes.rationale: Anti-ban measure: sends messages with 2–5s automatic delay between dispatches, and supports filtering by tags.

nodes.label: Traefik Reverse Proxy (n8n_default network)
nodes.rationale: Traefik used as reverse proxy to route vigasales.shop and www.vigasales.shop to the viga-sales container on port 3000, with automatic TLS via Let's Encrypt.

nodes.label: Cardiocor Contact Form → WhatsApp Redirect
nodes.rationale: Form submission redirects user to WhatsApp with pre-filled message including name, phone, subject and service selected.

nodes.label: Deploy Guide: vigasales.com.br DNS + Nginx + SSL
nodes.norm_label: deploy guide: vigasales.com.br dns + nginx + ssl

nodes.label: n8n Flow 4: Daily Prospecting Report via Email
nodes.norm_label: n8n flow 4: daily prospecting report via email

nodes.label: ICP: Construction Professionals (Engenheiros/Arquitetos/Construtores DF)
nodes.rationale: Ideal Customer Profile targets civil engineers, architects, builders and contractors in the Distrito Federal and surrounding areas. Pain point: frustrated with or inexperienced in marketing, relies on referrals.

nodes.label: Flow 1: Lead Generation via Google Maps + Apify
nodes.rationale: Scrapes Google Maps via Apify for businesses matching 5 search queries. Yields ~300-400 unique leads per run. Auto-deduplication by phone. Limitation: misses solo practitioners without Google presence. Apify is paid per run.
nodes.norm_label: flow 1: lead generation via google maps + apify

nodes.label: Flow 2: Automated WhatsApp Dispatch (Gemini AI messages)
nodes.rationale: Runs every 15 minutes, 8h-18h Mon-Sat. Each cycle fetches 3 prospects, Gemini generates personalized message, random 3-8 min delay (anti-spam), sends via Evolution API. Daily limit: 40 messages (safety cap below 66 max capacity).
nodes.norm_label: flow 2: automated whatsapp dispatch (gemini ai messages)

nodes.label: Flow 3: Follow-up (D+3 no reply)
nodes.rationale: Triggers 3 days after initial send with no response. Uses a different, more direct tone with social proof or qualification question.

nodes.label: AB Capital Landing Page (Consórcios sem juros)
nodes.norm_label: ab capital landing page (consorcios sem juros)

nodes.label: n8n Automation Service (n8n.vigasales.shop)
nodes.rationale: n8n orchestrates the prospecting automation flows (Flow 1, 2, 3, 4). Runs as a Docker container on the same VPS, accessible at n8n.vigasales.shop.
